description: Adds one more filter to a Sapphire Empath chain, and goes to the right of Empath or of another Empath Filter

params.text: Adds another Empath Filter to the right, cloned from this filter's settings, shifting the rest of the chain over to make room
Removes this filter from the chain, shifting the modules to the right back to close the gap
Sets the centre frequency of this filter
Attenuates and inverts the frequency CV
Sets the resonance of this filter in bandpass mode; in notch and comb mode it morphs the filter from a notch counter-clockwise to a comb clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the resonance CV
Places this filter's output in the stereo field
Attenuates and inverts the panning CV
Switches this filter between bandpass and notch or comb; the label beside the second knob changes from RES to MORPH to match
Sets the volume of this filter
Attenuates and inverts the level CV
Silences every filter in the chain except this one
Sets the gain of this filter's envelope follower output
Resets this filter to its default settings, leaving the other filters alone

inputs.text: Moves the centre frequency of this filter, tracking a volt per octave with the attenuverter fully clockwise
Varies the resonance, or the notch to comb morph in notch mode
Moves this filter's position in the stereo field
Varies the volume of this filter
Left audio returning into this filter; patching a dummy cable here keeps externally processed audio out of the chain
Right audio returning into this filter

outputs.text: Left audio leaving this filter for outboard processing
Right audio leaving this filter for outboard processing
Follows the amplitude of this filter. Clicking the ENV label switches to DCK, where the voltage is inverted so loud audio gives a low voltage

notes: this expander has no effect by itself: place it to the right of an Empath or of another Empath Filter, and it becomes one more filter of that chain.
holding Shift while clicking the add-filter button gives the new filter default settings, and holding Ctrl, or Command on a Mac, gives it a level of zero.
menu: Output limiter — on the LEVEL knob's own menu, not the panel menu: sets the threshold at which this filter's output is compressed, 1V to 10V with 6V the default, or turns it off
Limiter warning light — on the LEVEL knob's own menu, not the panel menu: turns off the red glow on that knob without turning the limiter off
Configure for V/OCT — on the FREQ attenuverter's own menu, not the panel menu: sets that attenuverter so the frequency CV tracks a volt per octave
Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero
